post.summary: Create an account and start a session.
Log in with email + password. A failure never reveals whether the email is registered.
Exchange a refresh token for a new access token + rotated refresh token.
End the current session. Its access and refresh tokens stop working immediately.
Create a project. The creator becomes its first project admin.

parameters.name: hasLateTasks
parameters.description: Only projects that have at least one late task.

get.summary: Projects screen: every project the caller can access, with task stats.

delete.summary: Project admins only. Soft delete; the ID is never reused.

get.summary: Members screen: members (with admin flag) and unanswered invitations.

patch.summary: Project admins only: make a member a project admin (or revoke admin, keeping at least one).

delete.summary: Project admins only. Takes effect on the removed person's next request.

post.summary: Project admins only: invite a registered user.

delete.summary: Project admins only: withdraw an unanswered invitation.

get.summary: Notifications screen: the caller's project invitations, newest first.
Unread badge shown on every page.

post.summary: Only the invited person can accept. They join the project on accept.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Planned date range start (YYYY-MM-DD). Tasks whose planned period overlaps [from, to] match.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches task name or ID (contains, case-insensitive).

get.summary: Project: Tasks screen. Late/Blocked are derived from today's date and the dependency graph.

post.summary: Create a task; optionally with dependencies (codes of tasks in the same project).

get.summary: Task details: allowed actions plus every task it waits on / that waits on it, with distance.

patch.summary: Edit name and planned dates. Status changes only through the action endpoints.

delete.summary: Delete a task and its dependency links. Its ID is never reused.

post.summary: Not started -> In progress. Allowed only when every task it waits on is done.
In progress -> Done.
Done -> In progress. Allowed only while no task that waits on it has started.
Make this task wait on another task of the same project. Cycles are rejected (409).

get.summary: The shared catalogue, visible to everyone logged in.

post.summary: Company store managers and SuperAdmins only.
Add stock arriving from a supplier.

parameters.name: projectCode
parameters.description: Company deliveries screen only: filter by project code.

get.summary: Company store: Deliveries screen (all projects, newest first).

post.summary: Send material from the company store to a project store.
Record a delivery coming back from a project: stock joins the company store.
Reject a delivery coming back from a project: stock returns to the project store.
Cancel a delivery the company store sent that is still in transit.

parameters.name: projectCode
parameters.description: Company deliveries screen only: filter by project code.

get.summary: Project: Deliveries screen (incoming and outgoing, newest first).

post.summary: Send material back to the company store.
Record an incoming delivery: stock joins the project store.
Reject an incoming delivery: stock returns to the company store.
Cancel a return this project sent that is still in transit.

info.title: SiteTrack API
info.description: Backend for SiteTrack: projects, tasks, dependencies, members, materials and deliveries. Authenticate with POST /auth/login, send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`, and refresh with POST /auth/refresh. See docs/API.md for response shapes and business rules.

ids.description: Invitation ids to mark as read. Omit to mark all as read.

dependsOn.description: Codes of tasks (same project) this task waits on.
Code of the task that must be done first, e.g. PRJ-0042-T-0003.

quantity.description: Positive number with up to 3 decimals; send as string or number, e.g. "12.5".
